title: Policy-Number Amendment Charge: Calculation Sheet, Cardinal Financial Responsibility Filing
content:
## Clause

When the named insured replaces the certified policy with a new Cardinal policy, a policy-number amendment moves the Cardinal Financial Responsibility Filing certificate onto the replacement policy and tells the ordering state its policy number, so that the certificate does not end with the policy it names. A policy-number amendment is charged the policy-change rate, which is 15.00 on every certificate type, and the policy-number amendment charge is that rate booked to the cent.

The policy-change rate is reduced by the policy-change courtesy percentage and rounded to the cent, giving the adjusted policy-change rate. The policy-number amendment charge is the timed policy-change charge plus the policy-change envelope charge, the replacement plan check charge and the limits re-certification charge, the sum rounded to the cent, and it is booked once per policy-number amendment, on its transmission.

## Lines of the calculation

| Line | Value |
|---|---|
| Policy-change rate | 15.00, every certificate type |
| Policy-change courtesy percentage | 0 percent |
| Adjusted policy-change rate | The policy-change rate reduced by the courtesy percentage, rounded to the cent |
| Timed policy-change charge | The adjusted policy-change rate |
| Policy-change envelope charge | 0.00 |
| Replacement plan check charge | 0.00 |
| Limits re-certification charge | 0.00 |
| Policy-number amendment charge | Timed, envelope, plan check and limits lines added together, rounded to the cent |

The courtesy reduction acts once, on the policy-change rate itself; the rounding to the cent happens at the adjusted rate and again on the final sum.

## Worked figure

- Policy-change rate: 15.00.
- Adjusted policy-change rate: 15.00 reduced by 0 percent: 15.00.
- Timed policy-change charge: 15.00.
- Policy-number amendment charge: 15.00 plus 0.00 plus 0.00 plus 0.00: **15.00**.
